why: phase-417 W4.c — `cancel`/`is_spinning` under rclcpp's own names, replacing a three-way disagreement: C had `nros_executor_stop` mutating a C-side state enum, C++ could not stop a spin without `shutdown()` tearing down the session, and Rust's `halt`/`is_halted` were `alloc`-GATED, so a core-only image could not stop its own executor at all. One flag, in Rust; C and C++ forward. ADOPT-BOUNDED (RFC-0089): `cancel` sets a flag the spin loop observes at the NEXT POLL BOUNDARY, so it returns before spinning has stopped -- `is_spinning` is the observable that says when it has. `is_halted` (cancel REQUESTED) and `is_spinning` (a loop is RUNNING) stay distinct; all four combinations are reachable.
